statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome
Symptoms are documented under diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) was billed
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating another payer should cover the service first
